intent: Original portrait covers inspired by user-provided guochao illustrations; no pasted poster or embedded lettering

prompts.plum: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original premium mobile mini-program home cover, one portrait artwork, exact 4:5 aspect ratio, ideally 1024x1280. Visual language: sophisticated contemporary Chinese guochao botanical screenprint / finely illustrated Chinese decorative poster, clean graceful shapes, restrained fine gold contours, subtle mineral-pigment grain, natural botanical fruit anatomy, layered orchard depth and flowing cream-and-gold auspicious cloud ribbons. Rich confident color, beautiful tactile detail, refined editorial art suitable beside Apple App Store typography. Composition must be newly designed for PORTRAIT, NOT a horizontal poster cropped, NOT two panels or collage. Main fruit-and-vessel composition stays in central 72% of width and central 45% of image height, spanning y=23%-66%; large luscious fruit visibly dominates. Top 10% is mostly quiet dark background. Bottom 29% stays richly colored but low-detail for white native UI title/date copy; no important object below y=70%. Peripheral branches/cloud arcs guide eye inward, spacious with strong silhouette. Keep at least 10% side margins around complete hero fruit. No type or lettering anywhere, no Chinese characters, no logos, no labels, no red stamp, no borders, no UI mockup, no photo, no 3D, no cute faces. Deliver exactly one full-bleed image. Subject: Qingmei green plum preserving. A graceful bough bearing three large fresh round pale-jade green plums, waxy soft highlights, anatomically plausible pointed olive leaves, small pale plum blossoms; a small elegant ochre-glazed narrow-neck pottery preserving jar with subtly carved rings, unlabelled, sealed by an understated cloth tie. The jar balances the fruit at lower right within the safe central zone; fruit larger than jar. Palette: deep emerald forest green background, luminous jade/lime fruit, restrained warm antique gold, soft ivory clouds. Distant spring plum orchard is a restrained silhouette high in background. Some flowing gold-lined ivory cloud ribbons pass behind branch and jar, without crowding. Aim for serene lush spring abundance with the jewel-like clarity of a very fine Chinese illustrated cultural poster.
